data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** f8b3427e49c5df3ea0c8b1399e88859be76bcd39
* **Context Scope:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (polling-phase PR resolution, ~lines 3002-3048); plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh (_state_file_path, _state_write_pr_meta)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

merge-to-main.sh --resume should resolve the in-flight PR number and continue the polling/merge phase, even after the state file loses pr_url/pr_number (the documented bug 7a0e failure mode).

#### Actual Behavior

On --resume, the state file (/tmp/merge-to-main-state-<branch>.json) contained staged_branch but no pr_number. The defense-in-depth GitHub fallback at merge-to-main-pr.sh:3032-3043 runs 'gh pr list --head $BRANCH --base ${_DEFAULT_BRANCH:-main}', which assumes the PR targets the DEFAULT branch. But in the two-channel flow, PR1 (worktree -> staged-*) targets the STAGED branch, not main. The fallback returns empty and the script exits 1 with 'ERROR: could not resolve PR number for polling phase', stranding an already-open, mergeable PR (#543). Manual recovery required repopulating pr_number into the state file. The fallback should query the open PR for $BRANCH without pinning --base to main (or try the staged base), and/or _state_write_pr_meta should persist pr_number before the version-bump phase completes so resume never loses it.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Discovered while completing merge-to-main for bug 5ec9-5f36-9851-42e9. PR #543: worktree-20260601-210835 -> staged-5c7b61186a68-1780415052.
data.title: merge-to-main-pr.sh --resume: PR-number fallback assumes base=main -> fails for staged-channel PR1 (worktree->staged)
